title: 🚗 A Retro Car Adventure with ☁️ Floating Clouds
description:
🚗 Retro Car Animation – Built with HTML & CSS

This project features a charming retro car animation crafted entirely using HTML and CSS. The animation brings a detailed car to life, with its body, headlights, and rotating wheels. The car appears to smoothly "drive" across the screen, creating a playful rocking effect powered by CSS keyframes.

🌤️ Fluffy clouds lazily drift across the sky from right to left, adding depth and enhancing the overall atmosphere. The combination of transforms, pseudo-elements, and precise positioning showcases the true potential of CSS in creating interactive and visually captivating effects—without needing any JavaScript.

This project is an ideal starting point for:

  • Beginners exploring CSS animation techniques

  • Developers seeking to practice creative styling in a lightweight, fun project.

✨ Make it your own by customizing the colors, timing, or even adding new elements to enhance the journey!
shortDescription: A charming CSS-only animation of a retro car with spinning wheels and drifting clouds, built using HTML and CSS for a playful, nostalgic scene.
